_comment: PixelLab asset manifest for the arena art set (generated 2026-06-13). Characters/objects persist in the PixelLab account by UUID; map_objects auto-delete ~8h after creation and must be re-generated if lost. Direction row order used in assembled sheets: south, south-east, east, north-east, north, north-west, west, south-west.
style: Omega Realm grimdark gothic (docs/design/STYLE_GUIDE_SHEET.png), low top-down, 48px characters on ~92px canvas

characters._zealot_comment: redesigned 2026-06-13 from a front/back concept (v3, 64px char on 128px canvas) — supersedes the original 96b88efc-e653-46c4-8350-456a41450803 (kept in account); anims idle/run/sprint/dash/attack/hit/death

map_objects._comment: expire ~8h after creation; status: downloaded = already saved to client/assets/sprites/environment/arena/

funerary_urn._comment: prompted as a sarcophagus, came out as an urn — kept

bot_animations._comment: idle (fight-stance-idle-8-frames, 8f), run (running-8-frames, 8f), death (falling-back-death, 7f) assembled per class to client/assets/sprites/players/<class>/ as 8-direction sheets + meta.json. Zealot has its own extended set.
